name: Hezrul Bloodmark
summary: At Lushwater Oasis, Hezrul Bloodmark directs the Kolkar incursions across the Barrens. Regthar Deathgate sends you to end his command and break the centaur's hold on the region.

sections.title: Decapitating the Kolkar
sections.body: After Barak Kodobane and Verog the Dervish fall, Hezrul Bloodmark remains the Barrens Kolkar's paramount chieftain. Regthar Deathgate calls him brutal and cunning, the spearhead behind the centaur incursions across the savanna. The Horde hopes his death will sow chaos and fracture the Kolkar ranks beyond recovery, before they can overwhelm Horde settlements.

sections.title: The Lushwater Stronghold
sections.body: Hezrul commands his warbands from Lushwater Oasis, south of the Crossroads. The few watering holes in the Barrens are vital to survival, making this oasis a strategic hub and a staging ground for Kolkar raiders. On Hezrul's own ground, you deny the centaur their most vital stronghold and sever their hold on the southern trails.

sections.title: A Dangerous Aftermath
sections.body: Regthar commends the victory over Hezrul and notes that the centaur lack the focused discipline of orcs. Yet the Kolkar do not scatter quietly. Enraged, they rally their remaining forces and launch a desperate, full-scale assault on Regthar's encampment for bloody vengeance.

faq.answer: Hezrul Bloodmark leads the Kolkar centaur across the Barrens. Fierce, cunning, and brutal, he directs their clans and raiders from Lushwater Oasis.

faq.q: Where can Hezrul Bloodmark be found?
faq.answer: Hezrul patrols the southern Barrens along the shores of Lushwater Oasis, south of the Crossroads, with Kolkar bodyguards at his side.

faq.q: Who gives the quest to kill Hezrul?
faq.answer: Regthar Deathgate, an orc warrior, gives the order at a small camp west of the Crossroads, on the road toward the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Why does the Horde want Hezrul dead?
faq.answer: The Kolkar threaten Horde trade routes and settlements. Regthar believes killing their paramount chieftain will fracture the clan's unity and greatly weaken its ability to wage coordinated war.

faq.q: What happens after Hezrul is slain?
faq.answer: The surviving Kolkar refuse to surrender. They unite in fury and launch an immediate counterattack against Regthar Deathgate's outpost west of the Crossroads.

faq.q: How does Hezrul relate to Barak and Verog?
faq.answer: Barak Kodobane and Verog the Dervish led individual oases and warbands as Kolkar subordinates. Hezrul Bloodmark commanded the entire clan across the Barrens.

angles.text: As an orc, you hear Regthar Deathgate judge the Kolkar by the ways of orcish warfare. The centaur are fierce, but their wild fury lacks the iron discipline honed by the Horde.
As a tauren, you know generations of brutal displacement and bloodshed at centaur hands. Defeating warlords like Hezrul brings hard-earned retribution.
As a member of the Horde, you know securing the Crossroads and the Barrens means breaking the centaur's hold on the three major oases that sustain travel through the region.
